request.text:
labels: A raised braid runs along the scalp with side sections feeding beneath its center, making the woven ridge stand above the surrounding hair.; 융기된 땋임이 두피를 따라 이어지고 옆 묶음이 중앙 아래로 들어가 주변 머리보다 땋은 능선이 솟아 보인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A raised braid runs along the scalp with side sections feeding beneath its center, making the woven ridge stand above the surrounding hair.
aliases: 더치 브레이드의 융기
